name: Algebra 1 Assessment / Evidence Philosophy — Derivative Retrieval Profile
authority_note: Original Unit Assessment Plan HTML is authoritative. This profile only makes repeated course philosophy easy for Bank/Course PMs to retrieve.

progress_language.Not Yet: learning outcome still developing; more practice, feedback, and evidence needed
progress_language.Approaching: growth toward mastery is visible; more evidence is needed for consistent mastery
progress_language.Meeting: sufficient evidence of mastering the learning outcome
progress_language.Exceeding: evidence of applying skills/concepts beyond the expected challenge of the learning outcome

bank_design_consequences: Evidence accumulates across independent opportunities toward Mastery Goals.
Meeting does not require perfection; the body of secure evidence should be sufficient, accurate, and independent.
Exceeding may emerge through transfer to less-familiar representations, contexts, or multi-step reasoning; no mandatory special Exceeding question is required.
Progress levels are not item-difficulty bands.
Response format follows profiles/bank_course_profile.json. Algebra canonical instructional items and Unit Summatives are constructed/open response; Blooket is the normal selected-response exception.
DOK describes the thinking after task design; it is not a quota engine.
